```{python}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

import sys, os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..")))
from src.backend.backend_functions import *

initialize_data()
player_color_map, archetype_color_map, decktype_color_map = get_color_maps()


def pick(df, cols):
    """Keep only displayed columns; keeps the ojs_define payload small."""
    if df is None or not hasattr(df, "columns"):
        raise TypeError(f"expected DataFrame, got {type(df)}")
    keep = [c for c in cols if c in df.columns]
    if not keep:
        raise KeyError(f"none of {cols} present; available: {list(df.columns)}")
    missing = [c for c in cols if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        print(f"[pick] missing (skipped): {missing}", file=sys.stderr)
    return df[keep].copy()


decks_with_standings = get_decks_with_standings()
standings = get_vintage_standings()


def counts_by_player(df, category, out_col):
    """Distinct deck count per (season, player, category), plus a Season-All roll-up.
    decks_with_standings is a merge of drafted_decks + standings, so it carries
    only real seasons -- the aggregate has to be built here."""
    per_season = df.groupby(["season_id", "player", category], as_index=False).agg(
        **{out_col: ("deck_id", "nunique")}
    )
    all_seasons = df.groupby(["player", category], as_index=False).agg(
        **{out_col: ("deck_id", "nunique")}
    )
    all_seasons["season_id"] = "Season-All"
    return pd.concat([all_seasons, per_season], ignore_index=True)


player_archetype_counts = counts_by_player(
    decks_with_standings, "archetype", "arche_types_count"
)
player_decktype_counts = counts_by_player(
    decks_with_standings, "decktype", "deck_types_count"
)


# --- player_stats: derived; there is no player_stats CSV ---------------------
# NB: games_played here means drafts attended, not MTG games (standings carries
# its own games_played column meaning the latter).
def _agg_stats(df, keys):
    out = df.groupby(keys, as_index=False).agg(
        games_played=("draft_id", "nunique"),
        total_wins=("standing", lambda s: (s == 1).sum()),
        total_points=("match_points", "sum"),
        average_omp=("OMP", "mean"),
        average_gwp=("GWP", "mean"),
        average_ogp=("OGP", "mean"),
    )
    out["avg_points_per_draft"] = out["total_points"] / out["games_played"]
    return out


def _mode_by(df, col, out_col, keys):
    """Most common archetype/decktype, counted over distinct decks."""
    counts = df.groupby(keys + [col], as_index=False).agg(n=("deck_id", "nunique"))
    return (counts.loc[counts.groupby(keys)["n"].idxmax(), keys + [col]]
                  .rename(columns={col: out_col}))


def _build(keys):
    out = _agg_stats(standings, keys)
    for col, name in [("archetype", "most_common_archetype"),
                      ("decktype", "most_common_decktype")]:
        out = out.merge(_mode_by(decks_with_standings, col, name, keys),
                        on=keys, how="left")
    return out


_all = _build(["player"])
_all["season_id"] = "Season-All"

player_stats = pick(
    pd.concat([_all, _build(["season_id", "player"])], ignore_index=True),
    ["season_id", "player", "games_played", "total_wins", "total_points",
     "avg_points_per_draft", "most_common_archetype", "most_common_decktype",
     "average_omp", "average_gwp", "average_ogp"],
)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

player_vs_stats = pick(
    get_vs_player_game_and_match_winrate(),
    ["season_id", "player", "opponent", "games_played_vs", "games_won_vs",
     "game_win_rate_vs", "matches_played_vs", "matches_won_vs", "match_win_rate_vs"],
)


# --- most_played_cards: top N per (season, player), derived from drafted_decks.
# The most_played_card_by_player CSV only carries the single top card and has no
# season_id, so it is rebuilt here. pick_count = drafts the card was in a deck.
TOP_CARDS = 10


def top_cards_by_player(df, n=TOP_CARDS):
    def _top(keys):
        counts = df.groupby(keys + ["card_name"], as_index=False).agg(
            pick_count=("draft_id", "nunique")
        )
        counts = counts.sort_values(keys + ["pick_count", "card_name"],
                                    ascending=[True] * len(keys) + [False, True])
        counts["rank"] = counts.groupby(keys).cumcount() + 1
        return counts[counts["rank"] <= n]

    all_seasons = _top(["player"])
    all_seasons["season_id"] = "Season-All"
    return pd.concat([all_seasons, _top(["season_id", "player"])], ignore_index=True)


most_played_cards = pick(
    top_cards_by_player(get_data("drafted_decks")),
    ["season_id", "player", "rank", "card_name", "pick_count"],
)
power_pieces = pick(
    get_power_pieces_by_player(),
    ["season_id", "player", "drafts_played", "seasons_played", "power_count",
     "avg_power_per_draft", "most_picked_power_card", "most_picked_power_count"],
)


# --- power_piece_picks: every power piece per (season, player), zeros included.
# power_pieces_by_player only carries the single most picked piece, so the
# per-card breakdown is rebuilt from drafted_decks. Keep in sync with
# POWER_PIECES in ManaCore's statistics_calculator.py.
POWER_PIECES = [
    "Black Lotus", "Gleemox", "Mana Crypt", "Time Walk", "Ancestral Recall",
    "Sol Ring", "Mox Poison", "Mox Sapphire", "Mox Pearl", "Mox Jet",
    "Mox Ruby", "Mox Emerald",
]


def power_picks_by_player(df):
    def _counts(keys):
        grid = (df[keys].drop_duplicates()
                  .merge(pd.DataFrame({"card_name": POWER_PIECES}), how="cross"))
        counts = (df[df["card_name"].isin(POWER_PIECES)]
                    .groupby(keys + ["card_name"], as_index=False)
                    .agg(pick_count=("draft_id", "nunique")))
        out = grid.merge(counts, on=keys + ["card_name"], how="left")
        out["pick_count"] = out["pick_count"].fillna(0).astype(int)
        return out.sort_values(keys + ["pick_count", "card_name"],
                               ascending=[True] * len(keys) + [False, True])

    all_seasons = _counts(["player"])
    all_seasons["season_id"] = "Season-All"
    return pd.concat([all_seasons, _counts(["season_id", "player"])], ignore_index=True)


power_piece_picks = pick(
    power_picks_by_player(get_data("drafted_decks")),
    ["season_id", "player", "card_name", "pick_count"],
)
# 'archtype' is the legacy (misspelled) column name; keep both so either survives.
player_archetype_winrate = pick(
    get_player_archetype_winrates(),
    ["season_id", "player", "archetype", "archtype", "games_won", "games_played",
     "game_win_rate", "matches_played", "matches_won", "match_win_rate"],
)
player_decktype_winrate = pick(
    get_player_decktype_winrates(),
    ["season_id", "player", "decktype", "games_won", "games_played",
     "game_win_rate", "matches_played", "matches_won", "match_win_rate"],
)
player_card_winrate = pick(
    get_combined_winrates_per_season(),
    ["season_id", "player", "card_name", "num_drafts_with_card", "games_won",
     "games_played", "game_win_rate", "matches_played", "matches_won",
     "match_win_rate"],
)

tables = [
    player_archetype_counts,
    player_decktype_counts,
    player_stats,
    player_vs_stats,
    most_played_cards,
    power_pieces,
    power_piece_picks,
    player_archetype_winrate,
    player_decktype_winrate,
    player_card_winrate,
]

players = sorted(decks_with_standings["player"].dropna().unique())

# 'Season-All' is a precomputed aggregate row in the source data; pin it first.
seasons = sorted({s for t in tables for s in t.get("season_id", pd.Series(dtype=str)).unique()})
if "Season-All" in seasons:
    seasons.remove("Season-All")
    seasons.insert(0, "Season-All")

ojs_define(
    players=players,
    seasons=seasons,
    player_archetype_counts=player_archetype_counts,
    player_decktype_counts=player_decktype_counts,
    player_stats=player_stats,
    player_vs_stats=player_vs_stats,
    most_played_cards=most_played_cards,
    power_pieces=power_pieces,
    power_piece_picks=power_piece_picks,
    player_archetype_winrate=player_archetype_winrate,
    player_decktype_winrate=player_decktype_winrate,
    player_card_winrate=player_card_winrate,
    archetype_color_map=archetype_color_map,
    decktype_color_map=decktype_color_map,
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Keeps rows for the selected player; season is only applied to tables that
// actually carry a season_id column.
function forSelection(rows) {
  return rows.filter(d =>
    d.player === player && (d.season_id === undefined || d.season_id === season)
  );
}

pct = d => (d == null || isNaN(d)) ? "" : (d * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"
pctRaw = d => (d == null || isNaN(d)) ? "" : d.toFixed(1) + "%"
num = d => (d == null || isNaN(d)) ? "" : d3.format(".2f")(d)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Sorts descending by `y`, optionally keeps the top `top` rows, and draws a bar
// chart. `rule` adds the 50% reference line.
function barChart(data, {x, y, yLabel, colors, top, rule = false, yMin,
                        height = 700, fontSize = 28, wrap = true} = {}) {
  const rows = data
    .filter(d => d.season_id === season)
    .sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a[y], b[y]))
    .slice(0, top ?? Infinity);

  const label = s => String(s).replace(/[_\s]+/g, "\n");
  const lines = wrap ? d3.max(rows, d => label(d[x]).split("\n").length) : 1;
  const rotate = wrap ? 0 : (rows.length > 12 ? -45 : 0);

  return Plot.plot({
    width,
    height,
    marginBottom: rotate ? height * 0.31
                : wrap ? fontSize * 1.2 * lines + 24
                : height * 0.16,
    marginLeft: fontSize * 2.5,
    style: {fontSize: `${fontSize}px`},
    x: {
      label: null,
      domain: rows.map(d => d[x]),
      ticks: rows.map(d => d[x]),
      tickFormat: wrap ? label : undefined,
      tickRotate: rotate,
      tickPadding: 8
    },
    y: {
      label: yLabel,
      labelArrow: "none",
      labelAnchor: "center",
      labelOffset: fontSize * 2.5,
      ticks: 5,
      grid: true,
      domain: yMin === undefined ? undefined : [yMin, d3.max(rows, d => d[y])]
    },
    color: {domain: Object.keys(colors), range: Object.values(colors)},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(rows, {x, y, fill: x, tip: true}),
      rule ? Plot.ruleY([0.5], {
        stroke: "gray", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeOpacity: 0.5
      }) : null
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Replaces the Dash DataTable: a search box plus a sortable, paged table.
function searchTable(rows, options = {}) {
  const search = Inputs.search(rows, {placeholder: "Filter rows…"});
  const out = document.createElement("div");

  const render = () => out.replaceChildren(
    Inputs.table(search.value, {layout: "auto", ...options})
  );

  search.addEventListener("input", render);
  render();

  const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
  wrapper.style.width = "100%";
  wrapper.style.height = "100%";
  wrapper.style.display = "flex";
  wrapper.style.flexDirection = "column";

  out.style.flex = "1";
  out.style.minHeight = "0";
  out.style.overflow = "auto";

  wrapper.append(search, out);
  return wrapper;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Most Played Cards"
// Only ever TOP_CARDS rows, so no search box, and lift Inputs.table's default
// ~11-row max-height (sized for 22px rows; this theme's rows are taller).
{
  const table = Inputs.table(forSelection(mostPlayedCardsData), {
    layout: "auto",
    header: {
      season_id: "Season",
      player: "Player",
      rank: "Rank",
      card_name: "Card Name",
      pick_count: "Pick Count"
    }
  });
  table.style.maxHeight = "none";
  // Shrink to the widest card name instead of spanning the whole card.
  table.style.width = "max-content";
  table.style.maxWidth = "100%";
  return table;
}
```



```{ojs}
//| title: "Power Cards"
// Summary row on top, then all power pieces with how often each was picked.
// Both are short, so no search box and no max-height (see Most Played Cards).
{
  const compact = table => {
    table.style.maxHeight = "none";
    table.style.width = "max-content";
    table.style.maxWidth = "100%";
    return table;
  };

  const summary = compact(Inputs.table(forSelection(powerPiecesData), {
    layout: "auto",
    header: {
      season_id: "Season",
      player: "Player",
      drafts_played: "Drafts Played",
      seasons_played: "Seasons Played",
      power_count: "Power Pieces",
      avg_power_per_draft: "Avg per Draft",
      most_picked_power_card: "Most Picked Power",
      most_picked_power_count: "Times Picked"
    },
    format: {avg_power_per_draft: num}
  }));

  const picks = compact(Inputs.table(forSelection(powerPiecePicksData), {
    layout: "auto",
    columns: ["card_name", "pick_count"],
    header: {card_name: "Power Piece", pick_count: "Times Picked"}
  }));
  picks.style.marginTop = "1.5rem";

  return html`<div>${summary}${picks}</div>`;
}
```
